copy.title: Built on proof, not vibes.
copy.description: Relay's scoring engine is tested against a golden dataset of real lead scenarios: won deals, strong opportunities, bad-fit leads, restricted remote roles, hybrid roles, and on-site roles. Every new intelligence version must pass calibration before it is trusted in-product.
copy.trustLine: Benchmarked. Calibrated. Tested against real scenarios. Human-reviewed.
copy.disclaimer: Benchmarks are internal quality gates, not guarantees.
copy.finalCta: Relay does not just generate. It evaluates, calibrates, and proves before it ships.
